videos.script: How many books did Recife sell? On a stream, that question has no answer. The sales never stop, so the total never stops changing. {{total}} The question that has an answer names a slice of time. Sales in these five minutes. Sales in the last ten. This customer's visit, however long it lasted. {{slices}} Each slice is a window, and there are four shapes. Tumbling windows sit side by side, like the hours on a clock. {{tumbling}} Hopping windows overlap, so one sale counts in several. Sliding windows follow the sales themselves, not the clock. {{overlap}} And session windows stretch for as long as the sales keep coming, and close after a quiet spell. {{session}} In this lesson you cut the same ten sales all four ways, with a pencil and a short program. Then one late sale arrives, and you find out what a window's result is worth before the stream is done with it. {{late}}
